intro:
The server has several different character types. It's worth noting that, despite their differences, every type has its own ways of progressing through the story and developing over time.

For example, Legendary Reincarnations can discover more about the past of the Legendary Pokémon they are fused with. Commonfolk can learn more about the regions they left behind. Eggs/Children can gradually learn, grow, and discover the world around them. Finally, Amalgams can work towards recovering their lost memories and piecing together their history.

entries.title: Basics
entries.text:
### Name
Your character's name. Please do not use anything offensive.

In case of nameless characters, especially those suffering from severe amnesia, you can use **???** to indicate that this character has no name. If you have a name planned, you can include it next to it in parentheses.

> *Example: ??? (Caryo)*

### Nickname *(optional)*
Your character's nickname. This can be a term of endearment, a title, or an abbreviation if the name is too long.

### Gender
The gender of your character. If your character uses neopronouns or any pronouns other than the expected ones, please write them down too.

### Species
The species of your character.

#### Fusion Name
The name of your fusion's species. It's usually created by combining the two Pokémon species you used to create it.

> *Example: Espe-Oh.*

#### Species 1 & Species 2
The species you used for your fusion.

### Age
Your Pokémon's age. In case of a Legendary, they cannot be younger than **16**.

### Type
The combination of types of your character.

#### Main Type 1 / Main Type 2
The two main types of your character. These must belong to the Pokémon you used for the fusion and will be the ones that will affect your weaknesses in combat.

#### Hidden Type
It **ONLY** serves as a third type for obtaining moves. It does not count towards STAB, weaknesses, or strengths.

> **Asking for a different type**
> It is often the case with older Pokémon, especially those introduced before the Fairy type was added, that it could be reasonably argued that they should have another type combination. If you believe a Pokémon should have a different type combination, tell the moderators. If we find your reasoning compelling, we'll consider allowing you to use that type as one of your main types.
>
> *For example, someone might argue that Lugia should be a Water type instead of a Psychic type. So, if approved, you can have Water & Flying as possibilities at the time to pick your types.*
>
> Something similar can be said for those characters that are fusions of Pokémon where one of the parts might be a monotype. In those cases you can choose a type that you think fits your fusion.

### Occupation
The occupation your character holds. This could be something they are currently working on or something they have done in the past.

### World of Origin
The world your Pokémon originates from. If it's from one of the games, add the region name. If it's not from the games, please add the name and a short description.

entries.title: Personality
entries.text:
This section is about personality. It's one of the most important sections for your character, so take your time. I'll leave some helpful links in each section, as well as some comments.

### Personality Traits
A list of your character traits. My personal recommendation is a minimum of **6**, with a mix of positive, negative, and neutral traits.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://www.novel-software.com/character-traits/

### Likes and Dislikes
A list of your character's likes and dislikes. At least **three** of each.

Now, it's true that everyone has their own tastes. However, my recommendation is that your character's likes and dislikes should tell us something unique about them. For example, listing that your character dislikes pain doesn't tell us much... But if you tell us that your character likes pain, that says a lot more about them.

> **Tip:** if you want to add a touch of *"Oh, I have changed"*, maybe add a like and a dislike that reflect how they were before they got fused. *For example, a character might have liked coffee before and now they dislike it.*

### Fears & Phobias
Your character's fears. No matter how brave you are, we all have something we fear to a greater or lesser degree. There must be **one**, but you can add more.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_phobias
> - https://www.ovrcome.io/post/how-many-phobias-are-there-a-nearly-complete-list-of-500-phobias
> - https://www.verywellmind.com/list-of-phobias-2795453

### In-Depth Personality
Your character's personality should be in detail. That means it should be at least **one compelling paragraph**. And no, having amnesia is not a personality.

My recommendation is that you build upon the previous points. How do those personality traits manifest? How do they act around others? What happens when someone triggers their worst fears? Maybe how their new bodies have affected them.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://litreactor.com/columns/character-personalities

entries.title: Abilities & Moves
entries.text:
Explanation of skills, moves, and the part that affects combat.

### Abilities

#### Common Talent
Your character's common talent. This type of skill can be used both in slice-of-life roleplay and outside of combat in dungeons. It must match one of your character's Main Types.

You can find the talents at: ⁠#common-talents

#### Special Talent
Your character's personal talent. This talent, like the Common Talent, can be used in both slice-of-life roleplay and dungeons while out of combat.

All we ask is that it fits your fusion at the very least.

> If your character can levitate or fly (even if it is not evident in the design, for example you are part Magnemite or a fish), you can add a small extra unique ability that describes how they move around.

#### Common Battle
This ability corresponds to the abilities of a Pokémon.

Here you can take any ability... as long as it makes sense and isn't unique to another legendary.

#### Unique Battle
The unique ability can be something completely custom or, if your character is a Legendary that has its own unique ability and you haven't chosen it, you can do so now.

### Moves
Your Pokémon's moves. Follow this format:

> **Move (Type/PP):**
> Description of the move.

In the case of legendaries, you can have up to **6 moves**. However:
- **1 must be your Legendary Signature Move** *(obligatory)*. In case your legendary doesn't have one, you can make a custom one. Check Changes first, as that legendary might have a move that comes from an alternate version of the character, like Articuno using the Signature Move of Galarian Articuno.
- **The other 5** can be any move that belongs to the three types you chose in Basics, as long as it is not another legendary's Signature Move.

entries.title: Backstory
entries.text:
Your character's backstory. We're not asking for a whole novel, but at least a good paragraph explaining who they are, where they come from, and what they were doing before their story began on the server is the bare minimum.

And no, having amnesia doesn't mean you don't have to write a backstory or can just make a bare-bones one.

### Where they come from
Remember that for all Legendary Reincarnations, the dominant Pokémon (the normal one) comes from outside Bethath. They can come from any kind of dimension, from a human world similar to our everyday lives to the canonical world of the games.

> While you can make references to other franchises when creating your characters, your character cannot come from that franchise. *Example: saying that your character is Batman.*

### Where it ends
In this type of backstory, what interests us is knowing what happened up until the point you entered Bethath. **Don't go beyond this point in time**, since this server provides a brief introduction to the characters starting from that point.

> Remember that centuries have passed since the Legendary Pokémon last appeared in other dimensions. So, while mentioning locations is fine, a lot has happened since, for example, Groudon and Kyogre last fought: enough for the people of Hoenn to have forgotten their names and appearance.

entries.title: Legacy Backstory
entries.text:
Legacy characters are a special class. These are characters that have remained since before the server reboot, and **only these characters** can use this type of backstory.

If a member owns one of these characters, they can choose whether to use the Legacy backstory type or the standard one.

The Legacy backstory type assumes the character has already spent a certain amount of time in Bethath and has already settled there. They might have opened a shop, adopted a child, or made friends.

> Basically, this backstory would be your character's story **plus** what they've been doing in Bethath since arriving.

entries.text:
Your character's appearance.

If you don't have fusion art in mind or can't find anything online, you can use the links below to find a good amount of fusions (though they will be in pixel art).

- **InfiniteDex:** https://infinitefusiondex.com/
- **FusionDex:** https://www.fusiondex.org/

> Remember to give **credit to the artists** in any case.

types.intro:
**Legendary Reincarnations** are fusions between a Legendary, Mythical, or Ultra Beast Pokémon and a regular Pokémon.

According to our lore, Legendary Reincarnations occur when a Pokémon from a dimension outside Bethath is forcibly transported to the region. In some cases, usually when the Pokémon arrives on its own, Bethath forces it to fuse with the soul of one of its Legendary Pokémon.

I'll mention this again in the backstory guidelines, but I want to make one thing clear from the beginning: **Legendary Reincarnations DO NOT remember their past lives as Legendary Pokémon.** The regular Pokémon's personality and identity are entirely dominant, even if the character suffers from amnesia.

entries.title: Basics
entries.text:
### Name
Your character's name. Please do not use anything offensive.

In case of nameless characters, especially those suffering from severe amnesia, you can use **???** to indicate that this character has no name. If you have a name planned, you can include it next to it in parentheses.

> *Example: ??? (Caryo)*

### Nickname *(optional)*
Your character's nickname. This can be a term of endearment, a title, or an abbreviation if the name is too long.

### Gender
The gender of your character. If your character uses neopronouns or any pronouns other than the expected ones, please write them down too.

### Species
The species of your character. If you plan to use a vanilla (unfused) Pokémon, just write the species name and ignore the steps below.

#### Fusion Name
The name of your fusion's species. It's usually created by combining the two Pokémon species you used to create it.

> *Example: Espe-Oh.*

#### Species 1 & Species 2
The species you used for your fusion. 

### Age
Your Pokémon's age. 

> From 12 onwards they can be any age. However, if you plan to put them in "danger" or use them in serious battles, please, keep it to 16+.

### Type
The combination of types of your character.

#### Main Type 1 / Main Type 2
The two main types of your character. These must belong to the Pokémon you used for the fusion and will be the ones that will affect your weaknesses in combat.

> **Asking for a different type**
> It is often the case with older Pokémon, especially those introduced before the Fairy type was added, that it could be reasonably argued that they should have another type combination. If you believe a Pokémon should have a different type combination, tell the moderators. If we find your reasoning compelling, we'll consider allowing you to use that type as one of your main types.

> *For example, someone might argue that Lugia should be a Water type instead of a Psychic type. So, if approved, you can have Water & Flying as possibilities at the time to pick your types.*

> Something similar can be said for those characters that are fusions of Pokémon where one of the parts might be a monotype or if you select a vanilla pokemon that is monotype. In those cases you can choose a type that you think fits your fusion.

### Occupation
The occupation your character holds. This could be something they are currently working on or something they have done in the past.

### World of Origin
The world your Pokémon originates from. If it's from one of the games, add the region name. 

If your character is not from the games, please add the name and a short description. If they are from Bethath simply write 'Bethath' and the Island they live in.

entries.title: Personality
entries.text:
This section is about personality. It's one of the most important sections for your character, so take your time. I'll leave some helpful links in each section, as well as some comments.

### Personality Traits
A list of your character traits. My personal recommendation is a minimum of **6**, with a mix of positive, negative, and neutral traits.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://www.novel-software.com/character-traits/

### Likes and Dislikes
A list of your character's likes and dislikes. At least **three** of each.

Now, it's true that everyone has their own tastes. However, my recommendation is that your character's likes and dislikes should tell us something unique about them. For example, listing that your character dislikes pain doesn't tell us much... But if you tell us that your character likes pain, that says a lot more about them.

> **Tip:** if you want to add a touch of *"Oh, I have changed"*, maybe add a like and a dislike that reflect how they were before they got fused. *For example, a character might have liked coffee before and now they dislike it.*

### Fears & Phobias
Your character's fears. No matter how brave you are, we all have something we fear to a greater or lesser degree. There must be **one**, but you can add more.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_phobias
> - https://www.ovrcome.io/post/how-many-phobias-are-there-a-nearly-complete-list-of-500-phobias
> - https://www.verywellmind.com/list-of-phobias-2795453

### In-Depth Personality
Your character's personality should be in detail. That means it should be at least **one compelling paragraph**. And no, having amnesia is not a personality.

My recommendation is that you build upon the previous points. How do those personality traits manifest? How do they act around others? What happens when someone triggers their worst fears? Maybe how their new bodies have affected them.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://litreactor.com/columns/character-personalities

### Common Talent
Your character's common talent. This type of skill can be used both in slice-of-life roleplay and outside of combat in dungeons. It must match one of your character's Main Types.

You can find the talents at: ⁠#common-talents

### Special Talent
Your character's personal talent. This talent, like the Common Talent, can be used in both slice-of-life roleplay and dungeons while out of combat.

All we ask is that it fits your fusion at the very least.

> If your character can levitate or fly (even if it is not evident in the design, for example you are part Magnemite or a fish), you can add a small extra unique ability that describes how they move around.

entries.title: Backstory
entries.text:
Your character's backstory. We're not asking for a whole novel, but at least a good paragraph explaining who they are, where they come from, and what they were doing before their story began on the server is the bare minimum.

And no, having amnesia doesn't mean you don't have to write a backstory or can just make a bare-bones one.

### Where they come from
Commonfolk can be natural inhabitants of the island, that means, that they have been born and raised in Bethath or they can be travellers, that means, that they come from a world outside Bethath.

> While you can make references to other franchises when creating your characters, your character cannot come from that franchise. *Example: saying that your character is Batman.*

#### Inhabitants
INHABITANTS are Pokémon born and raised in Bethath, in one of the villages under the protection of the NPCs. This type can include Commonfolk OCs and Egg OCs.

In these backstories, we need you to explain their life in Bethath, what they've been doing, and, if possible, their relationship with the NPC(s) assigned to them and the island they inhabit.

It's important to note that Pokémon within Bethath are born as fusions. Always. So, for them, a normal Pokémon is what they are. This includes mentions of humans. While they know they exist outside of Bethath, no one there has seen one in ages.

> And while you may know about the minor legendary Pokémon related to your island (Like for example, you know a legendary named Articuno once existed if you live in Sleigbell island), remember that they have been death for ages, that means that personally "knowing them" is nearly imposible. 

#### Travellers
Pokémon that come from outside Bethath. They can come from any kind of world, from a human world similar to our everyday lives, to the canonical world of the games. And while you can make references to other franchises when creating your characters, your character cannot come from that franchise. *Example: Saying that your character is Batman.*

In this type of backstory, what interests us is knowing what happened up until the point you entered Bethath. (Don't go beyond this point in time, since this server provides a brief introduction to the characters starting from that point.)

> Remember that centuries have passed since the Legendary Pokémon last appeared in other dimensions. So, while mentioning locations is fine, a lot has happened since, for example, Groudon and Kyogre last fought: enough for the people of Hoenn to have forgotten their names and appearance.

entries.title: Legacy Backstory
entries.text:
Legacy characters are a special class. These are characters that have remained since before the server reboot, and **only these characters** can use this type of backstory.

If a member owns one of these characters, they can choose whether to use the Legacy backstory type or the standard one.

The Legacy backstory type assumes the character has already spent a certain amount of time in Bethath and has already settled there. They might have opened a shop, adopted a child, or made friends.

> Basically, this backstory would be your character's story **plus** what they've been doing in Bethath since arriving.

types.intro:
**Children**, also referred to as **Egg Pokémon**, are a special character category focused more on the character's growth and development than on how strong they are. They're called Egg Pokémon because, most of the time, players can obtain them by hatching eggs found in dungeons.

It's important to note that all characters in this category are born in Bethath. They do not come from outside the region.

This is also one of the few character types that can evolve freely, as their entire mechanic revolves around growing up, developing, and gradually becoming stronger.

**Does this mean I can't have child characters through other means?**

Nope! You can still have child characters through an Amalgam, since their age isn't explicitly defined. However, as a general rule, all characters under the age of 12 fall into this category.

entries.title: Basics
entries.text:
### Name
Your character's name. Please do not use anything offensive.

In case of nameless characters, especially those suffering from severe amnesia, you can use **???** to indicate that this character has no name. If you have a name planned, you can include it next to it in parentheses.

> *Example: ??? (Caryo)*

### Nickname *(optional)*
Your character's nickname. This can be a term of endearment, a title, or an abbreviation if the name is too long.

### Gender
The gender of your character. If your character uses neopronouns or any pronouns other than the expected ones, please write them down too.

### Species
The species of your character.

#### Fusion Name
The name of your fusion's species. It's usually created by combining the three Pokémon species you used to create it.

> *Example: Espe-Oh.*

#### Species 1, 2 & 3
The species you used for your fusion. Amalgams, must have three types.

> **Asking for a different type**
> It is often the case with older Pokémon, especially those introduced before the Fairy type was added, that it could be reasonably argued that they should have another type combination. If you believe a Pokémon should have a different type combination, tell the moderators. If we find your reasoning compelling, we'll consider allowing you to use that type as one of your main types.

> *For example, someone might argue that Lugia should be a Water type instead of a Psychic type. So, if approved, you can have Water & Flying as possibilities at the time to pick your types.*

> Something similar can be said for those characters that are fusions of Pokémon where one of the parts might be a monotype. In those cases you can choose a type that you think fits your fusion.

### Age
Your Pokémon's age. Because these Pokémon may be centuries old, but their age was frozen in time until their purification, you can simply write their apparent age. If you want to add their chronological age, you can do so next to it in parentheses. Example: 30 (500)

### Type
The combination of types of your character.

#### Main Type 1 / Main Type 2 / Main Type 3
The three main types of your character. These must belong to the Pokémon you used for the fusion and will be the ones that will affect your weaknesses in combat.

### Occupation
The occupation your character holds. This could be something they are currently working on or something they have done in the past.

### Island
The island of Bethath your character comes from.

entries.title: Personality
entries.text:
This section is about personality. It's one of the most important sections for your character, so take your time. I'll leave some helpful links in each section, as well as some comments.

### Personality Traits
A list of your character traits. My personal recommendation is a minimum of **6**, with a mix of positive, negative, and neutral traits.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://www.novel-software.com/character-traits/

### Likes and Dislikes
A list of your character's likes and dislikes. At least **three** of each.

Now, it's true that everyone has their own tastes. However, my recommendation is that your character's likes and dislikes should tell us something unique about them. For example, listing that your character dislikes pain doesn't tell us much... But if you tell us that your character likes pain, that says a lot more about them.

> **Tip:** if you want to add a touch of *"Oh, I have changed"*, maybe add a like and a dislike that reflect how they were before they got fused. *For example, a character might have liked coffee before and now they dislike it.*

### Fears & Phobias
Your character's fears. No matter how brave you are, we all have something we fear to a greater or lesser degree. There must be **one**, but you can add more.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_phobias
> - https://www.ovrcome.io/post/how-many-phobias-are-there-a-nearly-complete-list-of-500-phobias
> - https://www.verywellmind.com/list-of-phobias-2795453

### In-Depth Personality
Your character's personality should be in detail. That means it should be at least **one compelling paragraph**. And no, having amnesia is not a personality.

My recommendation is that you build upon the previous points. How do those personality traits manifest? How do they act around others? What happens when someone triggers their worst fears? Maybe how their new bodies have affected them.

> **Useful documentation**
> - https://litreactor.com/columns/character-personalities

entries.title: Abilities & Moves
entries.text:
Explanation of skills, moves, and the part that affects combat.

### Abilities

#### Common Talent
Your character's common talent. This type of skill can be used both in slice-of-life roleplay and outside of combat in dungeons. It must match one of your character's Main Types.

You can find the talents at: ⁠#common-talents

#### Special Talent
Your character's personal talent. This talent, like the Common Talent, can be used in both slice-of-life roleplay and dungeons while out of combat.

All we ask is that it fits your fusion at the very least.

> If your character can levitate or fly (even if it is not evident in the design, for example you are part Magnemite or a fish), you can add a small extra unique ability that describes how they move around.

#### Common Battle
This ability corresponds to the abilities of a Pokémon.

Here you can take any ability... as long as it makes sense.

#### Unique Battle
The unique ability can be something completely custom or a canon ability from the games as long as is not unique to a legendary.

### Moves
Your Pokémon's moves. Follow this format:

> **Move (Type/PP):**
> Description of the move.

You can have up to **5 moves**, plus **1 Custom Move**.

5 Moves must belong to the three types you chose in Basic Info. As long as it is not another's legendary Signature Move, you can chose any. The last move can be a custom one you can create, and that will be unique for your character.

entries.title: Backstory
entries.text:
Your character's backstory. We're not asking for a whole novel, but at least a good paragraph explaining who they are, where they come from, and what they were doing before their story began on the server is the bare minimum.

Amalgams are characters that can have two origins: either a corrupted common folk or a purified dungeon amalgam.

It's worth noting that all amalgams suffer from amnesia. Having lost all their memories up to the point of their purification, they can recover them over time through events.

While creating a backstory isn't required in this case, it's still a good idea.

entries.title: Legacy Backstory
entries.text:
Legacy characters are a special class. These are characters that have remained since before the server reboot, and **only these characters** can use this type of backstory.

If a member owns one of these characters, they can choose whether to use the Legacy backstory type or the standard one.

The Legacy backstory type assumes the character has already spent a certain amount of time in Bethath and has already settled there. They might have opened a shop, adopted a child, or made friends.

> Basically, this backstory would be your character's story **plus** what they've been doing in Bethath since arriving.

entries.title: Appearance
entries.text:
Your character's appearance.

If you don't have fusion art in mind or can't find anything online, you can use the links below to find a good amount of fusions (though they will be in pixel art).

- **InfiniteDex:** https://infinitefusiondex.com/
- **FusionDex:** https://www.fusiondex.org/

> Remember to give **credit to the artists** in any case.

types.intro:
**Amalgams** are a special character type that can only be obtained through an in-RP quest. This means that no member can start with an Amalgam, with the exception of **LEGACY members**, who are allowed to keep their Amalgams after the reboot.

An Amalgam character is essentially the purified version of the enemies players can encounter throughout the different dungeons. The Pokémon combination becomes exclusively yours, even if it happens to match one of the Amalgams used as enemies in our dungeons.

According to our lore, Amalgams have two posible origins. They are the original inhabitants of Bethath, that after the **Shattering**, were forcibly fused together. Or they might be a corrupted commonfolk.

> Check more about the corruption in : corruption.

Purification can restore their sanity and allow them to regain their sense of self, wich is the character you now control. Unfortunately, however, it cannot bring back their lost memories.
